Chapter 7181: High Heaven Sect

Chapter 7181: High Heaven Sect

Left and Right Splendor fled instantly after releasing the lamp. The content was none other than An Ran’s let-go self that had been refined. The purpose was to explode Octopus’ lair.

An Ran’s previous self was meant to fight the high heaven. Thus, it baited an incredible number of tribulations capable of instantly filling the endless abyss to the brim.

“Boom!” The overflowing tribulations returned to Heavenrealm and Desolate Frontier.

“It’s coming.” The defenders prepared for another wave.

However, the tribulations were weaker this time because of An Ran’s interference. Not only did he push away the ocean, he also forced the avatar to appear above. He was a monster blocking the pathway for the tribulations, leaving behind a smaller gap.

The source bolt, high heaven dao rune, and primordial trees could handle the waves and eventually refine them down.

“Yes!” Spectators cheered upon seeing the successful stop. Perhaps their worlds could actually survive.

Alas, their celebration was short-lived, interrupted by drums. The first reaction was that more reinforcement was coming for Desolate Frontier.

However, they noticed the drums originated from Epoch Dawn and Heavenly Fortress World.

Portals opened and mighty immortals appeared outside of Grand Thousand World, initiating an assault.

“What is going on?!” Spectators were livid and horrified.

Grand Thousand World and its primordial tree was pivotal currently in refining the express tribulation bolts. Losing it meant potentially losing the Bulwark of Apocalypse.

During the time of crisis, everyone thought Epoch Dawn and Heavenly Fortress were here to help. After all, they were at risk of destruction just like the rest.

“Are they insane?” An immortal murmured.

“Sheng Shengxian, Di Ting, World Monarch, Ninth Lady, Lord of Fortress, Matron of Fortress...” Someone named the primordial immortals.

It appeared these two worlds have planned this for a long time.

“What are you doing, Sheng Shengxian?” Hao Cai became alarmed.

Grand Thousand World didn’t fear this in the past but currently, their powers were focused on refining the tribulations.

“Brother, we are delivering justice in the heaven’s stead.” Sheng Shengxian said.

“Justice?” Wang Weiqiao led other immortals to start a smaller defensive formation outside of Grand Thousand World.

“Exactly as I said, we act to support the high heaven.” Sheng Shengxian said.

“Putting Heavenly Fortress aside, your Epoch Dawn is a part of Heaven Assault Alliance, created to attack the high heaven.” Hao Cai became confused.

“No, from today henceforth, Heaven Assault Alliance is no more, the same with Epoch Dawn and Heavenly Fortress. Only High Heaven Sect shall remain.” Sheng Shengxian said.

Everyone became confused about this new faction.

“High Heaven Sect?” Immortal Emperor Xue Xi was furious.

“Buzz.” Sheng Shengxian and the others raised their fingers and shockingly blinded their eyes.

When they opened their eyes again, tribulations could be seen coursing within.
